target.rawSql:
SELECT 
  * 
FROM 
  (
    SELECT 
      cleaning_start_datetime AS now 
    FROM 
      user_mbrcleaninglogandchemicalconsumptiondata
    WHERE $__timeFilter(cleaning_start_datetime) 
      AND mbr_train = '1' 
      AND cleaning_type = 'Acid MC' 
  ) ct, 
  (
    SELECT 
      cleaning_start_datetime AS time, 
      cleaning_stop_datetime AS timeEnd, 
      cleaning_type AS tags 
    FROM 
      user_mbrcleaninglogandchemicalconsumptiondata 
    WHERE $__timeFilter(cleaning_start_datetime) 
      AND mbr_train = '1' 
      AND cleaning_type = 'Acid MC'
  ) pt

FROM "mqtt_consumer" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval)

FROM 
(SELECT "MBR-CalcParameters-TMP20200mqtt" + 32.323529 AS A
FROM "mqtt_consumer" 
WHERE time < '2022-05-27 14:30:00'),
